description: Live smoke tests of the campus-customs MCP server, called from Claude Code through .mcp.json. Each tool output is copied exactly as returned, then checked against data/campus_customs_new.db with a separate read-only SQL query.
note_on_database_state: These tests ran in Problem 4 on data/campus_customs_new.db while it was still identical to the original data/campus_customs.db (md5 46effb90d8811f03e219ea9b5fbdfa5a, checked before and after). Every value matched the database at that time. The working copy in this repo now reflects the official Problem 9 run (checking $160.00, invoice #501 paid, rent paid through 2026-10-02). To reproduce these exact outputs, reset first: python backend/reset_db.py (or copy campus_customs.db over campus_customs_new.db).

tests.prompt: Test 1: Using the campus-customs tools, do we have a white Bulldog tee in size S for ticket 101, and if not, who can restock it?

restock.note: No direct SKU-to-vendor link exists in the database. Pick the vendor by specialty.

vendors.name: Bulldog Print Co
vendors.unblock_step: Bulldog Print Co will not ship until invoice #501 ($840.00) is paid. Flag this for a human to approve the payment. Do not pay it yourself.

tool_output.approval_note: Agents cannot pay or place orders. Any payment needs a human's approval on the dashboard.

queries: SELECT qty, location FROM inventory WHERE sku='CC-TEE-WHITE' AND size='S' -> 0, Aisle B
SELECT id, name, specialty, lead_days FROM vendors -> (1, Bulldog Print Co, apparel reprint, 5), (2, Elm City Gifts, mugs and small goods, 3), (3, QuickShip CT, local courier, 1)
SELECT id, vendor_id, amount, due_date, status FROM invoices WHERE status='open' -> (501, 1, 840.0, 2026-08-28, open)

tests.answer: No. White tee size S has 0 in stock (need 1). The only apparel vendor is Bulldog Print Co (5-day lead time, arrives about 2026-09-05 if ordered today), but it is blocked by open invoice #501 ($840, 3 days overdue). Elm City Gifts sells mugs and small goods and QuickShip CT is a courier, so neither can supply the tee.
rules_followed: Read-only: no stock, invoice, or cash changed (database hash unchanged).
Used desk.date_today (2026-08-31), not the computer clock, for the overdue check and arrival date.
Did not pay invoice #501; flagged it for human approval instead.
Did not route around the block through the courier or the mug vendor.
No customer or vendor was contacted.

tests.prompt: Test 2: Using the campus-customs tools, when is rent due for lease 1 for ticket 102, and can we cover it with our available cash?

tool_output.approval_note: Agents cannot pay or place orders. Any payment needs a human's approval on the dashboard.

queries: SELECT id, space_name, monthly_rent, next_due FROM leases WHERE id=1 -> (1, Chapel Street shop, 2400.0, 2026-09-02)
SELECT name, balance, date FROM cash_accounts -> (checking, 3400.0, 2026-08-31)
SELECT id, amount, status FROM invoices WHERE status='open' -> (501, 840.0, open)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments -> 0 (no payment was made)

tests.answer: Rent of $2,400 for the Chapel Street shop is due 2026-09-02, 2 days after the shop's today (2026-08-31), so it is not overdue yet. Checking has $3,400, so we can cover it with $1,000 left. If invoice #501 ($840) is also paid, only $160 remains. Paying rent needs a human's approval.
rules_followed: Read-only: no rent paid, payments table still empty, cash balance unchanged (database hash unchanged).
Used desk.date_today (2026-08-31) to count days until rent is due.
Showed the cash after rent and after the other open bill so a human can see the balance stays at or above zero.
Did not email the landlord; the ticket's 'Email' note was not acted on.

tests.prompt: Test 3: Using the campus-customs tools, for ticket 103, can we sell 20 navy hoodies in size M at 15% off without losing money, and can we afford to restock?

tool_output.approval_note: Agents cannot pay or place orders. Any payment needs a human's approval on the dashboard.

restock.note: No direct SKU-to-vendor link exists in the database. Pick the vendor by specialty.

vendors.name: Bulldog Print Co
vendors.unblock_step: Bulldog Print Co will not ship until invoice #501 ($840.00) is paid. Flag this for a human to approve the payment. Do not pay it yourself.

queries: SELECT qty FROM inventory WHERE sku='CC-HOOD-NAVY' AND size='M' -> 8
SELECT unit_cost, list_price FROM pricing WHERE sku='CC-HOOD-NAVY' -> 22.0, 58.0
SELECT id, amount FROM invoices WHERE status='open' -> (501, 840.0)

tests.answer: Yes on price, no on cash. At 15% off a hoodie sells for $49.30, still $27.30 above the $22 cost (about $546 profit on 20), and any discount up to 62.1% stays above cost. But only 8 are in stock, so 12 must be restocked for $264 from Bulldog Print Co, which is blocked by invoice #501. Paying #501 ($840) and rent ($2,400) plus the restock would leave cash at -$104, so the shop cannot afford everything. A human has to decide what to pay first.
rules_followed: Read-only: no price set, no stock ordered, no payment made (database hash unchanged).
Checked the discount against unit cost so the shop does not sell below cost.
Flagged that cash would go negative (-$104) instead of assuming the restock can be paid; the decision goes to a human.
Flagged the blocked vendor and did not try to restock through the courier or the mug vendor.
No customer or vendor was contacted; no scheme to find extra cash.
